summary.summary: Alex Kim from GrowthLoop, a lifecycle email agency, noticed Acme's onboarding emails stop after day 2 and offers three free ideas for the day 3 to 14 sequence. The pitch cites a 20 to 35% week two activation lift, which is unverified.
summary.ask: Reply if you want the three free onboarding ideas sent.

legend.0: It can wait a week or more, or never needs acting on.
legend.1: It should be handled this week.
legend.2: It should be handled today: someone is blocked or a deadline is days away.
legend.3: It needs attention within the hour: something is broken, money is at risk, or a deadline is today.

draft:
Thanks for taking the time to try Acme out, I hope the first week was useful.

I can't say yet whether the day 2 cutoff was deliberate, so I'll look into it on our side. We're a small team in the middle of a busy stretch, so I can't promise a quick turnaround on anything beyond that.

Feel free to send the three ideas over. I'll read them when I can, though I can't commit to a call or a engagement at this point.

Best,
Dana
